patterns: APPSC asks single facts: Katantra = Sarvavarma, guild interest 12%, Kolika = weavers, ship coins = Yajna Sri, metals used (no nickel/gold), official language Prakrit.
APPSC Group-1 term items: 'Katakas and Skandhavaras' = military camps serving as administrative centres; Gulmika; Nigama Sabha.
APPSC Group-2 2025 uses statement/A-R pairs: Roman trade declined post-Satavahana (A false, R true); Gathasaptasati love themes true, Brihatkatha in Sanskrit false.
Traps: Brihatkatha language Paishachi not Sanskrit; Gathasaptasati not a political-history source; iron-copper coated coins belong to a later Andhra dynasty.
App bank is far larger and deeper (port identifications, Gathasaptasati social details, officer lists, long match items) than the short APPSC items.
